set.title: Television and Evening Routines
set.intendedMeaning: Mary's television-viewing routine and a short interruption to it.
set.protectedContent: Mary; television; TV; one hour; eleven o'clock

conflict_resolution: Prefer a longer construction-specific match over an overlapping generic match.
Compose non-overlapping atomic edits belonging to the same issue.
If candidate repairs alter protected quantities or process order, suppress them.
Reparse each candidate; reject repairs that create a new high-confidence finding.

promotion_rules: No parser-general family may be promoted solely on SET-0022 evidence; only separately approved bounded surface patterns are executable.
local_auto requires zero false positives on approved controls and at least 0.99 precision on sealed evaluation data.
Semantic and coreference families remain review-only even when their candidate repair matches the source target.
Style families must not contribute to grammatical-error counts.
Holdouts must contain vocabulary absent from the development examples and must stay partition-separated.

sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 關係代名詞 who 指向單數的 student，因此現在式動詞要用第三人稱單數 enjoys。
show 是可數名詞單數，作動詞受詞時不能在沒有冠詞、所有格、數詞或其他限定語的情況下單獨使用。此句的 usually 表示習慣，所以教師版本採用 TV shows；若意思是每晚看一個未指明的節目，a TV show 亦正確。
sourceNotes: 教師目標答案為複數，但不定冠詞單數亦可；執行時只提示覆核，不自動改寫。

sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示「在夜間」的固定時間副詞片語是 at night，不用定冠詞。只有當 night 屬於較大的名詞片語時才可保留 the，例如 stared at the night sky。
主語 programmes 是複數，因此連綴動詞 be 要用 are。
主語 they 是複數，所以一般現在式動詞使用原形 make，不加 -s。
主語 her younger brother 是第三人稱單數，因此一般現在式動詞要用 sits。
複數代名詞 they 在過去進行式中要配合 were，不用 was。
過去式已由助動詞 did 表示，後面的實義動詞必須回復原形 see，不能再用過去式 saw。
children 是 child 的複數形式，因此過去式 be 要用 were。
可數名詞在大於一的數詞後通常要用複數，因此是 two episodes。
指出精確鐘點時使用介詞 at，例如 at eleven o'clock；in 通常用於月份、年份、較長時段或表示多久之後。

ruleFamilies.name: Finite verb agrees with its syntactic subject
ruleFamilies.explanationZhHant: 這個規則族處理「Finite verb agrees with its syntactic subject」所描述的文法結構；執行時必須同時符合已核准的比對條件與保護條件。

ruleFamilies.name: Determination or plural marking for a bare singular count-noun argument
ruleFamilies.nameZhHant: 裸用單數可數名詞須加限定語或改為複數
ruleFamilies.explanationZhHant: 單數可數名詞作論元時，通常需要冠詞、所有格、數詞或其他限定語；若語意是一般或重複多個事物，可改用複數。當兩種讀法都成立時，只提示覆核並保留候選答案。

ruleFamilies.name: Zero article in the fixed temporal expression at night
ruleFamilies.nameZhHant: 固定時間片語 at night 不用定冠詞
ruleFamilies.explanationZhHant: 表示一般「在夜間」時使用固定片語 at night；只有 night 屬於帶修飾語的名詞片語或具指涉、標題等讀法時才保留 the。

ruleFamilies.name: Base-form lexical verb after finite do-support
ruleFamilies.nameZhHant: do 助動詞後使用動詞原形
ruleFamilies.explanationZhHant: do、does 或 did 已承擔時態及人稱屈折，後面的實義動詞必須使用原形。

ruleFamilies.name: Plural count noun after a numeral greater than one
ruleFamilies.nameZhHant: 大於一的數詞後使用可數名詞複數
ruleFamilies.explanationZhHant: 當數詞表示大於一的完整個體，後面的可數名詞通常使用複數；複合修飾語、零複數及單位符號須另作保護。

ruleFamilies.name: At introduces a precise clock time
ruleFamilies.explanationZhHant: 精確鐘點通常由 at 引入，例如 at eleven o'clock；若介詞屬於其他詞彙配價、標題或時限結構，則不可直接套用。

sourceControls.correctExample: Mary is a student who enjoys watching television.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 關係代名詞 who 的先行詞是單數 student，因此動詞用 enjoys。

sourceControls.correctExample: Mary watches a TV show after dinner. Mary watches TV shows after dinner.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: a TV show 表示一個未指明節目；TV shows 表示一般或重複習慣，兩者都可避免裸用可數名詞單數。

sourceControls.correctExample: Mary watches television at night. She stared at the night sky.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 時間副詞片語用 at night；night 修飾 sky 時，the 屬於整個 the night sky 名詞片語。

sourceControls.correctExample: Her favourite programmes are cartoons, and they make her laugh.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 複數主語 programmes 和 they 分別配合 are 和 make。

sourceControls.correctExample: Their parents allow them to watch television for one hour.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 此句是完整的乾淨控制：allow + object + to-infinitive；for one hour 表示時長。

sourceControls.correctExample: Mary did not see the ending.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: did 已承擔過去時，後面的動詞使用原形 see。
children 是複數，過去式 be 使用 were。
數詞 two 後的可數名詞 episode 使用複數 episodes。

sourceControls.correctExample: Mary went to bed at eleven o'clock.

testCases.inputText: They stared at the night sky.
testCases.boundaryNote: The head noun is sky; night is a compound modifier, so the article is valid.

testCases.inputText: Ben did not went home early.
testCases.expectedCorrectedText: Ben did not go home early.

testCases.inputText: We bought three ticket for the concert.
testCases.expectedCorrectedText: We bought three tickets for the concert.
testCases.boundaryNote: A count noun after three requires plural inflection.

testCases.inputText: Later, Mary watched two episode and went to bed in eleven o'clock.
testCases.expectedCorrectedText: Later, Mary watched two episodes and went to bed at eleven o'clock.
testCases.boundaryNote: Published SET-0022 evidence for at before a precise clock time.

testCases.inputText: The lesson ends at eleven o'clock.
